data.name: Missionaut
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Missionaut is an online adventure RPG built around exploration, progression, and mission-driven gameplay.

Step into a growing world filled with strange creatures, dangerous areas, useful resources, and NPCs who need your help. Complete missions, unlock new paths, gather materials, craft equipment, and develop your character through a wide range of skills.

Whether you are repairing broken systems, fighting powerful enemies, helping NPCs, or discovering new parts of the world, every mission pushes you further into the adventure.

Explore, Fight, and Progress

Travel through different areas, battle enemies, collect loot, and take on challenges that reward preparation and teamwork. Some encounters can be handled alone, while others may require strategy, better gear, or help from other players.

Mission-Based Gameplay

Missionaut is built around handcrafted missions with dialogue, choices, objectives, conditions, and rewards. NPCs and world objects can react to your progress, opening new paths and changing what you can do next.

Skills and Crafting

Train different skill paths, gather resources, refine materials, and create useful items. Your progression is not just about combat — it is about building up your character and becoming more capable across the world.

Play Your Way

Focus on combat, crafting, gathering, exploration, or helping others complete difficult objectives. Missionaut is designed to grow over time with new missions, skills, enemies, items, and areas.

Key Features

  • Online adventure RPG gameplay

  • Mission-driven progression

  • NPC dialogue, objectives, and rewards

  • Combat against creatures and bosses

  • Gathering, refining, and crafting systems

  • Character skill progression

  • Solo and group-friendly challenges

  • A growing world designed for future updates

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU, 1 GB VRAM or modern integrated graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a stable internet connection. System requirements may change during development.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Stable broadband internet connection recommended for online play.
